cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Recruit Them Twice
cards.instruction: Recruit them to your side, then reveal that the side, goal, or conflict is not what it first appeared to be.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Help me save the club garden. Bring the extension plan; we'll mark exactly which beds are threatened.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. Who approved building over them?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We did. Please follow the boundary line; our signatures cover the paved area and these two beds.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought we'd only signed off the paving.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then mark those two beds separately. Will you stand with me while we ask to withdraw that part of our approval?
